item.title: DCC refers retail pharmacy deregulation proposals to sub-committee, including removal of pharmacist name from licence
item.description: In a significant step toward easing the regulatory burden on India's retail pharmacy sector, the Drugs Consultative Committee (DCC) at its 68th meeting on 20 March 2026 directed a sub-committee to examine four landmark deregulation proposals. The sub-committee's findings will be placed before the DCC for final deliberation before any rule amendments are made.
